# Manifest UI — Design System

This repository documents the Manifest website design system.
All components are plain HTML + BEM CSS (no framework, no React).

## Quick start for agents

1. Read `registry/components.json` for a complete machine-readable index of all
   components, their BEM classes, modifiers, elements, and required tokens.
2. Read `src/pages/components/<name>.astro` for full documentation and HTML
   snippets for any specific component.
3. The design system CSS lives in `src/styles/manifest.css`. Copy it or link it
   in any HTML page to apply all styles.

## Rules when building a new page on the Manifest website
- Always use BEM classes from the registry. Never invent new class names.
- Always use CSS custom properties (--color-*, --space-*, --radius, etc.)
  instead of hardcoded values.
- Check the modifier list in components.json before adding a new variant.
- The canonical source of truth is the mnfst/website repo CSS.

## Repository structure
- registry/components.json — machine-readable component index
- src/pages/tokens/ — design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, etc.)
- src/pages/components/ — one page per component with preview + code
- src/styles/manifest.css — the complete design system CSS
